digest.component_or_area: MCP server error handling and CLI/library error classification
propositions: MCP tool failures must emit the same structured error discriminator (error_envelope) that the CLI already emits, carrying machine-readable error code + human message + input + optional exit_code

A single central classifier error_code_for(exc)->str plus KNOWN_ERROR_CODES frozenset must define the shared vocabulary, sourced once and consumed by library, CLI, and MCP without duplication or drift

MCP errors delivered via raised McpEnvelopeError (on ToolError.__cause__) must preserve existing agent-branching fields (kind, resolution_class, retryable, diagnostic) while adding the vocabulary error code

Error codes must be classified by exception type (isinstance checks for ConcurrencyError/ConcurrencyMismatch, TicketNotFoundError, etc.) not by pattern-matching human message strings, ensuring AC4 stability
The read facade and two soft-error returns (_mcp_reads explain_criterion, _mcp_llm) must migrate from ad-hoc shapes to the envelope while retaining domain-specific decision signals

CLI output remains byte-identical (ticket_not_found emitted at reads.py not-found sites via TicketNotFoundError subclass, deps_failed at reads.py does-not-exist via bare ReadError, message-keyed at reads_cli.py:410)
